user.title: Carrot HA
user.description: Enter the device ID and a dedicated random token of at least 32 characters. Use the same credentials in the sender.

init.title: Vehicle receiver, camera and SOC settings
init.description: Set the SOC calculation capacity for your vehicle. This is not a battery degradation measurement.

data.camera_token: Dedicated camera token (32+ characters, separate from other tokens)
data.terminal_ha_url: External HA HTTPS URL (automatic terminal connection)
data.receiver_url: Own vehicle receiver URL (internal HTTP or external HTTPS)

error.invalid_capacity: Enter a finite capacity between 20 and 150 kWh.
error.invalid_cloud: Enter an HTTPS base URL without a path and a view token.
error.invalid_camera_token: Use a separate 32–256 character ASCII token without whitespace.
error.invalid_terminal_token: Use a terminal-only 32–256 character ASCII token different from every other token.
error.invalid_terminal_setup: Check the external HA HTTPS base URL and vehicle receiver configuration.
error.invalid_receiver: Use an HTTPS receiver URL (HTTP only on a private local network), with distinct 32+ character upload and view tokens.
